prompt: Research and value Uber after a curated-video high-risk buy lead.

inputs.trigger: The curated screen called Uber a great buy while explicitly describing it as a high-risk bet; current issuer growth and cash generation justify a full risk-adjusted review.
inputs.research_focus: Assess mobility, delivery, advertising and membership economics; test autonomous-vehicle displacement and investment risk, regulation, insurance, stock compensation, capital returns, cash conversion and valuation; treat the video only as a lead.
